exposure: sociodemographic factors (age, marital status, education, employment status)
outcome: women's preferences for mode of delivery
cohort: 383 women aged 18-45 years in the Hail region of Saudi Arabia.
finding: Most women in the Hail region preferred vaginal delivery, but they exhibited moderate overall knowledge with significant gaps regarding cesarean risks and postpartum complications, particularly for the latter across all demographic groups.
mod_finding: Among participants, 54.6% preferred vaginal delivery, 16.2% preferred cesarean delivery, and 29.2% were undecided, with higher knowledge observed for vaginal delivery compared to cesarean section.
